scope: Browser voice calls: ElevenLabs, OpenAI Realtime and Hume EVI; Levantine Arabic and English. No telephony changes.
status: Manual real-microphone listening suite prepared; not executed by this automated run.

targets.notes: Working product targets, not measured guarantees. Provider and SDK timings do not establish sound at the listener.

protocol: Use the same synthetic persona facts and tasks on each provider. Repeat cases on quiet headphones, speakers, room noise, desktop/mobile and typical Wi-Fi. Rate naturalness, pronunciation, persona consistency and task success separately; report actual provider/voice, failure rate, median and p95. Preserve voice IDs. No raw microphone recording is required.
